The player would need to draw lands on consecutive turns just to start playing the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Put Plains on the bottom of the library, keeping a zero-land hand
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Bulwark Giant (the 6-mana card that is least impactful and hardest to cast) and keep the Plains to have a functional hand with Turn 1 Speaker of the Heavens or Scroll of Avacyn, Turn 2 Guardian Idol.

annotations.description: Bottoming Serra Angel during mulligan when it's the strongest card available and the hand has plenty of Plains to cast it. Serra Angel (4/4 flying vigilance) is the best win condition among these 7 cards, and with 5+ Plains already in hand, reaching 5 mana is trivial.
annotations.actionTaken: Put Serra Angel on the bottom of the library
annotations.betterLine: Bottom Scroll of Avacyn instead, keeping Serra Angel as a powerful finisher. The ideal 5 to keep would include Thriving Heath, Plains, Guardian Idol, Serra Angel, and Celestial Enforcer (or Faith's Fetters), bottoming Scroll of Avacyn and the weaker remaining card.

annotations.description: Passed priority with 1 untapped Plains and two castable 1-mana spells in hand (Anointed Chorister and Scroll of Avacyn), wasting the mana for the turn.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting anything, leaving 1 mana unused.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Anointed Chorister for {W} to develop a 1/1 lifelink body alongside the Celestial Enforcer, making efficient use of all available mana this turn.
